description: This file defines application-wide constant values, including preference key strings and a fare rate, used across the Flutter application. It provides a class 'AppConstants' that encapsulates these constants for consistent access throughout the codebase.

classes.name: AppConstants
classes.description: A class containing static constants for preference keys and configuration values, mirroring the keys from the original Kotlin app and used throughout the Flutter project.
